canonical_business_target: Predict whether total merchant sales will decline by at least 15% over the next 7 days relative to the trailing 28-day daily-sales baseline.

merchant_decline_development_best.name: Calendar Safeguarded Verifier
merchant_decline_development_best.role: Canonical internal development evidence for merchant-level 7-day decline detection
merchant_decline_development_best.scientific_boundary: Development result only. Fresh independent external merchant validation is required before production-performance claims.

portable_runtime.name: Sales Sentinel Portable ExtraTrees
portable_runtime.role: Pure-Python production-compatible runtime implementation for transaction-rich 7-day decline-risk scoring
portable_runtime.decision_policy: Static threshold during warm-up, then causal percentile mode when sufficient prior V18 scores exist.
portable_runtime.important_note: V18 is the deployment/runtime representation. It must not be reported as a separate higher-accuracy experimental model unless evaluated under an explicitly comparable protocol.

point_sales_forecast.name: Adaptive Merchant Forecast
point_sales_forecast.role: 7-day and 30-day merchant sales-value forecast using merchant-local, horizon-aware rolling backtests. Candidate selection minimizes horizon-total WAPE first and daily WAPE second.
point_sales_forecast.scientific_boundary: Quality is merchant- and horizon-specific. Use the horizon-total WAPE stored with each run as the primary point-forecast quality measure. This runtime does not create a global production-accuracy claim.

legacy_uci_point_forecast.name: ridge_raw_1
legacy_uci_point_forecast.role: Historical UCI-trained point-forecast artifact retained for reproducibility only; it is no longer the default website point-forecast engine.
legacy_uci_point_forecast.must_not_be_used_for: Merchant decline-risk model performance claims or current point-forecast quality claims

redsea_mendeley.boundary: Short external window; useful for transfer diagnostics but insufficient by itself for a production-readiness claim.

redsea_adaptive_forecast_v3.boundary: This is a real Saudi Redsea transfer diagnostic, not fresh blind validation. Redsea had already been inspected during development and spans only about four months. The 90.49% figure applies only to the 30-day horizon-total 1-WAPE diagnostic and must not be reported as universal model accuracy.

redsea_real_runtime_v18.boundary: This proves the official Saudi XLSX can flow through XLSX normalization, SQLite ingestion, feature generation, and V18 scoring. It is not an accuracy claim and not fresh blind external validation.

v16_2_transfer_diagnostic.note: Recorded as transfer/calibration evidence only. Redsea had already been observed during iteration, so these numbers are not fresh blind validation.

claim_rules: Do not describe the localized UCI transaction data as real Saudi merchant transactions.
Do not use plain accuracy alone as the primary metric for the imbalanced decline target.
Do not present SAMA city/market-risk metrics as merchant Sales Sentinel metrics.
Do not claim RED/severe-risk classification is supported.
Do not report one global point-forecast accuracy for Adaptive Merchant Forecast; report horizon-specific merchant/run WAPE.
Do not report the Redsea 30-day 90.49% horizon-total quality proxy as universal production accuracy.
Do not claim production validation until an independent longitudinal Saudi merchant dataset is evaluated without tuning on it.
